description: Turn one thread into a crew: dispatch parallel agent ships in their own worktrees and land their work when it reports DONE. Ships get isolated git worktrees, scouts stay read-only, and every crew ends with a DONE, BLOCKED, or FAILED verdict. Thread events ping you the moment a crew finishes, fails, or stalls, and a crew that idles without a verdict gets nudged until it reports. Queue work with dependencies, gate merges behind green checks, and hand whole projects to domain captains. Requires the bb CLI on the host; the optional real firstmate toolbelt clones upstream firstmate scripts.
